findings.issue_text: app/assets/stylesheets/common/base/header.scss:35 — Replacing `.panel`’s `float: right` with `margin-left: auto` breaks right alignment in the non-Ember/noscript header because `.panel` is nested inside `.row` and is not a flex item
app/assets/stylesheets/common/foundation/mixins.scss:121 — `-ms-align-items` is not a valid IE/Edge property and is always ignored; the redundant declaration should be removed

app/assets/stylesheets/common/foundation/mixins.scss:127 — `order()` passes modern zero-based or negative values directly to the one-based `-webkit-box-ordinal-group` and `-moz-box-ordinal-group`, producing invalid values and inconsistent legacy flexbox ordering

goldens.comment: Mixing float: left with flexbox causes layout issues. Further this PR removes the float-based right alignment for .d-header .panel, which may cause the login panel in the non-Ember/noscript header (where .panel is nested inside .row and not a flex item) to stack under the title instead of remaining right-aligned.
-ms-align-items never existed in any version of IE/Edge; the correct legacy property is -ms-flex-align.
-webkit-box-ordinal-group and -moz-box-ordinal-group require values starting from 1, not 0. If $val is 0, this will cause incorrect rendering in older browsers, leading to layout issues.
